_readme: All user-facing copy, plans/prices and company-page section presentation. Edit here, then run launch/deploy_preview.sh. {x} = value filled in by the code.

plans._note: Display only. Stripe price IDs are Supabase Edge Function secrets STRIPE_PRICE_SINGLE / _M10 / _M30 / _Y10 / _Y30 (see HOW-TO-CHANGE.md). checks = checks per month; must match PLAN in supabase/functions/regretamin-stripe-webhook and CHECKS in create-checkout. amount = price in dollars (used to show code discounts). yearly = the same plan billed yearly (kind y10/y30), checks still refill monthly.

sections._note: Company page sections, in display order. renderer = facts | checks | legal | press | founders | people | timeline (js/company.js). Remove an entry to hide a section. The DB only supplies the data per key.
